warm_bath.name: Treatment package (up to four rooms, linen, laundry)
warm_bath.src: and m (project decision, 15 Nov 18:25); sizes from (project chat web read; trade and maker sources, trust 30-50, not codes); each part carries its own source line. Package minimum 31.5 m2 = one red light 4.5 + one treatment 11.1 + linen 3.7 + laundry 12.2 (two rooms); reference 71.4 m2 = two red light 7.4 + two treatment 13.0 + linen 5.6 + laundry 25 (four rooms, 5 h); ceiling (maxM2) 85 m2 with the 8 h laundry (39). The laundry day is sourced . Red light is a wellness room, not therapy, on any card or board (thin health-claim evidence). One establishment: counts toward the 500 m2 cap, flag only.
